## Change / 变更

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. / 说明问题及变更后的行为。

## Design / 设计依据

Link the relevant SPEC or issue. / 关联 SPEC 或 issue。

## Verification / 验证

List commands and actual results; mark checks not run. / 列命令及实际结果，标明未运行项。

- [ ] Build and formatting pass / 构建及格式检查通过
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation agree / 中英文文档一致
- [ ] Failures and unsupported cases are explicit / 错误及不支持的情况明确失败
- [ ] Dependency locks and notices updated if needed / 按需更新依赖锁及声明
- [ ] Public API, state format, or recovery changes have the required review / 公共接口、状态格式或恢复变更已按要求评审
